decision: deft update --dry-run plan is construction-level collection via one injected write/remove/exec port. PR 3453 is replace after architecture-independent salvage. #3437 stays open until the replacement that implements ADR-004 merges.

governingRule.description: Dry-run fidelity is a property of construction, not helper discipline. Dest mutations on the deft update path go through one injected write/remove/exec port. Collect-only mode and a labeled two-tree dest-vs-content-package diff are rejected.

alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Five bypass instances; omission-shaped; fs-import ban cannot see child_process. The fifth (git config on dry-run) proved the write surface is not one category.
Dest membership is dest-aware writer logic (~16 files / ~30 branches). The exclusions contract is omission-shaped. Cannot answer which dest files are deleted vs preserved.
Every side effect must be root-parameterized; git config already is not; scratch would need a git repo. Honest form collapses into the port.
#3437 remains a lying dry-run for file-level blast radius. Version-skew (#3464) is not the whole consumer question.

whyWinner: The port records dest membership from the same construction that executes. Static ban plus zero-mutation fixture make bypass CI-red, including git config. Three accepted conditions (enforcement legs, consolidation not introduction, honest label) stay unweakened. Salvage independent 3453 pieces first; close 3453 unmerged; keep #3437 open until the replacement PR.
revisitTrigger: If a later inventory finds dest-mutating injectors on the update path beyond the three recorded seams, amend ADR-004. Re-open only if a later ADR shows the port's migration cost worse than root-parameterizing git config and $HOME OpenClaw.
